_comment: Per-scenario median-wall budgets for the wasi-microbench host-path regression detector (#583, W11-6). The bench fails CI when median_ns > median_ns_budget * (1 + threshold_pct/100); threshold defaults to 10. Calibrated 1.5x over the median observed on the Azure D16pds_v6 AArch64 dev VM at 2025-11-23 (commit f15be260). Updating: see docs/wasi.md § 'Updating the wasi-microbench budget'.
